gates.analyse_skip_reason: No PHP in this repository: it is an Astro/TypeScript static site, so the analyse gate (which only fires on changed *.php) can never run. Static analysis here is `astro check` + `tsc --noEmit` + ESLint, run as npm scripts and in CI once the toolchain is scaffolded. Re-run /groundwork:init after scaffolding to record verified commands.
gates.handoff_skip_reason: No frontend consumes an API from this repository: it is a static Astro site whose pages are its own frontend, so there is no contract to hand off.
